verdict.rationale: Sandbox platforms can plausibly ship MCP-consumption features, such as gateways that give the agent in a sandbox access to configured MCP servers, so this axis applies. However, the evidence never documents registering or plugging in MCP servers for tool use. The only MCP mention (docs-16) describes protocol controls that govern remote MCP traffic over HTTP/HTTPS. That is an adjacent network-policy feature, not MCP-client tool consumption.
